title: Essential final answer (1)
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide a numerical refractive index for part (1), approximately 1.38.

title: Essential final answer (2)
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide a numerical refractive index for part (2), approximately 1.7.

title: Geometry for angle θ
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the angle of incidence θ using the geometry of the person, hole height, and distance (L=0.6m).

title: Geometry for angle α
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly relate the hole's diameter and depth to find the maximum allowed angle α inside the medium for complete imaging.

title: Apply Snell's Law (1)
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply Snell's law (n = sinθ / sinα) correctly to find the refractive index for part (1).

title: Critical angle condition (2)
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the response must identify the condition for grazing exit (incidence angle = 90°) and apply n = 1 / sinα.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The working should demonstrate consistent use of units (meters, centimeters) or correct unitless ratios.

title: Pitfall: Confusing angles
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student confuses the incident angle θ with the internal angle α, or misidentifies which is the grazing angle.

title: Pitfall: Trigonometry error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize significant errors in trigonometric calculations (e.g., wrong ratio for tanθ or sinα).
